diagram.title: Four different deployment boundaries
diagram.prediction: Which row is tested by the exported object alone?
diagram.reading: Follow the flow from validated raw request through preprocessing and artifact loading to the numeric call and encoded response. The exported object proves only its graph/signature boundary; the wrapper owns request validation and response meaning. The recorded fresh process reloads the bytes and reproduces \( (3.1,-0.45)\), while the \( (2,3)\) shape is rejected. To extend the claim, retain evidence for every new runtime boundary.
diagram.alt: Read top to bottom from the raw request to the response. Each row has a distinct contract and a distinct failure. The exported computation handles the numeric call; request fields, artifact identity and response meaning require surrounding checks. The fresh-process experiment exercises loading and calling under the installed CPU runtime.
